source: I want the players in my social game to form meaningful friendships and connections if they get along. Can you help me by creating a private bedroom that two players can be teleported to? I need help with both designing the layout and writing a teleportation script. Start with the teleportation script.

image_prompt.text: An open floor area in the bedroom for the two players to gather in
A large distinct structure visible from a distance that tells the player where they are
a private bedroom sized and furnished for exactly two players to share

layout_placement.text: The arrival point inside the bedroom where both players land, placed so the first thing they see is composed
The paired destination marker that the teleport script sends both players to

notes: Classified no-genre: the user named a social game but described a place, and a single private room is not a game type. If this room sits inside a full roleplay town, reclassify to Roleplay & Avatar Sim and the picks merge by shared ID with nothing lost.
The preset is a poor fit at this scale - a gathering space and a distant landmark are both written for an outdoor crowd, and this is one interior room for two people.
The user asked for the teleportation script first. That is not something this pipeline produces; only the destination marker survives into the handoff.
